subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the Snowflake Fairy. Her human appearance comes from <Picture 1>: the same young adult East Asian woman with an ornate black hair bun, silver and pale-blue ornaments, flowing pale-blue embroidered robes, white inner layers, and white boots. In human form, she holds one silver sword in her RIGHT hand and performs magical seals with her LEFT hand. Her transformed dragon appearance comes from <Picture 3>: a two-hundred-meter-long wingless white Chinese dragon with pearlescent scales, green eyes, branching antlers, flowing white mane and whiskers, and four clawed limbs. These are TWO FORMS OF THE SAME INDIVIDUAL.
<Subject 2> is Yan Mo from <Picture 2>: the muscular masked man with decorated dreadlocks, exposed mouth, bare torso, red cape, and ochre waistcloth. He transforms into a THREE-HUNDRED-METER-TALL volcanic flame giant. His final defensive transformation converts his entire giant body into one turbulent fireball approximately three hundred meters across.
<Subject 3> is the sunset desert from <Picture 4>, preserving the golden sun on the left, rocky plain, drifting dust, and jagged formations on the right. Nearby thirty-to-fifty-meter rocky ridges provide persistent scale references.

summary:
[reference generation] A 20-second, 16:9 live-action fantasy feature-film sequence featuring two fighters. <Subject 1> confronts <Subject 2>, who becomes a colossal flame giant and punches through her ice defense. Injured beneath a mountainside, she transforms her own body and equipment into the white dragon referenced in <Picture 3>. Her transformation ruptures the ground irregularly. She ascends in dragon form and releases freezing breath while hovering. The giant transforms into an immense fireball to defend. The final image freezes on the ice-versus-fire contact.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (Shots 1–2, 4–5, 7–9): partially_preserved - preserve her human identity, costume, and sword before transformation; use <Picture 3> for her completed dragon form. Her human body and equipment merge into the same transformation.
<Subject 2> (Shots 1–4, 6, 8–9): partially_preserved - preserve his original identity through the continuous transformation from man to volcanic giant to defensive fireball.
<Subject 3> (all shots): partially_preserved - retain recognizable geography and sunset lighting while accumulating broken terrain, dust, frost, and scorch marks.

detailed_description:
Photorealistic live-action fantasy with feature-film photography, tangible materials, directional sunset light, atmospheric depth, and physically integrated effects. Preserve scale through fixed landmarks. Both fighters remain individually traceable through their transformations. Fast actions carry continuously across cuts, while both spoken lines remain complete and intelligible.

[Shot 1] A ground-level wide shot catches <Subject 1> plunging steeply from the sky. She abruptly stops with her boots exactly five centimeters above the sand. Her robes overshoot downward before settling, and compressed air sweeps dust outward. <Subject 2> watches from farther right. A rocky foothill behind her and distant jagged formations establish the battlefield.

[Shot 2] Cut to a waist-up three-quarter view. The camera pushes closer as she points her RIGHT-hand sword at him. <Subject 1> (S1), with a clear, forceful female Mandarin voice and synchronized lip movement, angrily commands: <d>[Chinese] 炎魔，还不乖乖束手就擒！</d>

[Shot 3] Cut to a distant wide view retaining both characters and the same rocky ridge. <Subject 2> (S2) throws back his head, laughs, and pounds his chest with both fists. His body continuously expands. Skin cracks into thick volcanic plates, exposing moving magma.

His legs rise above the ridge, followed by his enormous torso and head, until he reaches three hundred meters. The woman remains a tiny pale-blue figure beside his feet. The nearby ridge stands below his knees. His feet compress the ground into deep depressions, and his shadow sweeps across the plain. Flames roll from his shoulders while dark smoke partially obscures his distant head. His enlarged ivory mask retains its recognizable silhouette and exposed mouth.

[Shot 4] Cut to a rising three-quarter tracking view. <Subject 1> and her sword dissolve together into one white-blue ice stream, accelerating upward toward the giant's torso. He plants his feet, twists his chest, and draws his RIGHT fist behind his shoulder.

As he punches across her flight path, her ice stream spreads into a broad, six-branched snowflake shield in midair. Show the entire interception continuously: his knuckles strike the center, crystalline ribs bend inward, cracks branch outward, and the same continuing punch shatters the shield. Her human body and RIGHT-hand sword re-form behind the breaking ice. Transmitted force snaps her backward and hurls her down toward the foothill.

[Shot 5] Cut on her continuing backward flight. The camera tracks her into a back-and-shoulder collision with the rocky wall. Stone fractures at the contact point, fragments burst outward, and dust billows around her. She drops to the mountain base, still gripping her sword. Preserve the broken wall and scattered rubble in subsequent views.

[Shot 6] Cut to a low-angle view of the giant's face and upper chest. His enormous shoulders loom against the sky; his exposed mouth remains readable beneath the scorched mask. Looking down toward her impact site, <Subject 2> (S2) speaks in a deep Mandarin voice with synchronized mouth movement and a contemptuous laugh: <d>[Chinese] 传闻中的雪花仙子也就这点能耐，哈哈哈！</d>

[Shot 7] Cut through thinning dust to <Subject 1>, kneeling on one knee beneath the broken wall. A small trace of blood marks her mouth. Her RIGHT hand braces the sword against the earth while her LEFT hand forms a seal.

Frost spreads over her skin, robes, and sword. She pulls the blade free as her entire body and equipment dissolve together into one dense, continuous mass of white-blue ice vapor. The camera pulls back without cutting away from this transformation. Her human silhouette disappears into the same expanding material.

Within that material, a long serpentine silhouette develops: her head becomes the referenced white dragon's antlered head, her body elongates into its immense scaled torso, four clawed limbs take shape, and a flowing tail extends behind her. The vapor condenses into tangible pearlescent scales, green eyes, white mane, and long whiskers matching <Picture 3>.

Pressure beneath the growing dragon first tilts one off-center slab. A jagged fracture tears diagonally along an existing rock joint, changes direction, and branches into unequal cracks. Some branches stop early; others widen into offset cavities. One bank collapses inward while the opposite bank lifts in uneven blocks. Cold vapor bursts through separate gaps at staggered moments. The rupture has varying width, nonparallel edges, and unequal elevations.

As her dragon form completes, her entire body levitates above the broken ground. Show clear open air beneath her belly, all four tucked claws, and the full trailing tail. The white dragon is now the complete transformed body of <Subject 1>.

[Shot 8] Cut to a side tracking view as <Subject 1>, now entirely in dragon form, raises her head, roars, and climbs sharply. Her whole body follows the upward curve, four legs tucked and motionless, mane streaming backward. Mountains and drifting dust recede far below.

At approximately two hundred meters above the plain, she brakes into a controlled hover facing the giant, leaving several hundred meters between them. Waves pass along her spine and tail to stabilize her airborne position.

She opens her jaws. White frost gathers deep in her throat and spills between her teeth. Responding to this visible preparation, the giant folds his arms across his torso. His head, limbs, and volcanic body dissolve inward into rolling molten fire. The same material expands into one monumental fireball occupying his previous position. Its surface churns with dense orange flame, dark smoke folds, and incandescent volcanic fragments. His entire body becomes this defensive form.

[Shot 9] Cut to a wide aerial three-quarter view containing the hovering white dragon, the immense fireball, and the valley far below. <Subject 1> remains airborne at a stable distance and exhales a continuous, high-pressure stream of freezing white-blue vapor. The breath has a dense turbulent core, torn cloud edges, and trailing ice crystals.

The breath crosses the open air and strikes the fireball's facing surface. At the exact contact patch, flames flatten inward and sweep around the cold stream. Ice crystals flash into dense steam, which erupts upward in irregular plumes. The turbulent fireball holds against the pressure while the dragon sustains her breath. Keep a clear stretch of open air between her snout and the fireball throughout.

Freeze the entire image for the final half-second: the transformed white dragon hovering on the left, the immense defensive fireball on the right, and the freezing breath visibly pressing into its surface between them.

overall_soundscape:
Desert wind underlies chest blows, volcanic cracking, shield fracture, and the mountainside impact. The woman's transformation adds rushing ice, crystalline condensation, staggered stone snaps, and grinding slabs. Her dragon roar gives way to high-altitude wind, a sustained freezing jet, roaring fire, and violent steam hissing at the contact surface. Both dialogue lines remain clear.

non_diegetic_music:
Low strings and deep percussion build during the giant's growth, receding beneath dialogue. Brass and rapid strings rise with the woman's dragon transformation and ascent, followed by a sustained low chord during the ice-and-fire confrontation. The score stops on the final frozen image.
